title: Geometric stalks detect isomorphisms of etale sheaves of sets
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $(\bar s_i:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_i\to S)_{i\in I}$ be a family of geometric points of $S$ [def-weil-geometric-point] whose images cover $S$ (every point of $S$ is the image of the point of some $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega_i$), and let $\varphi:F\to G$ be a morphism of sheaves of sets on $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. If for every $i\in I$ the induced map of stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] $\varphi_{\bar s_i}:F_{\bar s_i}\to G_{\bar s_i}$ is bijective, then $\varphi$ is an isomorphism of sheaves of sets, i.e. $\varphi_W:F(W)\to G(W)$ is bijective for every object $W$ of $S_{\Et}$.

source.place: Theorem Tag 03PU (theorem-exactness-stalks): a map of sheaves of sets on S_etale is injective (resp. surjective) iff it is so on the stalks at all geometric points; a map of sheaves of sets that is injective and surjective is an isomorphism. Its proof only uses, for every point u, some geometric point over u, so a family of geometric points covering S suffices (as recorded for lem-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-detect-mono).
